_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. chargetrip.com is a Framer build: its --token-<uuid> palette is the product's own paper, ink, orange, green and alpha colours (duplicated uuids folded onto the first one that resolves to the value). "var" leaves resolve through the live document; "value" leaves are measured.

cta-orbit.description: The decorative orange disc behind the CTA group.

cta-orbit-deep.description: The darker orange disc layered under it.

dark-orbit.description: The lifted-ink disc inside the dark plan card.

form-ink.description: The sales-form field text, a near-black teal unrelated to the ink ramp.

signin-paper.description: The account.chargetrip.io 'Create account' card fill (oklch, resolved).

ui.description: Geist Variable across the UI: controls, nav, body copy (Placeholder is Framer's in-canvas stand-in).

display.description: Cirka, the editorial serif of the display headings and plan-card prices.

h1.description: The page-H1 size away from the home hero, 64px.

small.description: Footer links and check-list items, 16px at 22.4px.

page.description: The warm-cream page ground (the body element's own fill, painted identically at both widths).
page.source: computed backgroundColor of page-ground default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.200

card.description: The plan-card and footer-panel fill, a near-white on the cream page.
card.source: computed paint.0.bg of plan-card default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.0

dark.description: The dark island: the hero band and the 'Popular' plan card.
dark.source: computed paint.0.bg of plan-card-dark default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.800

primary.description: Body and heading ink on the light pages.
primary.source: computed color of section-title default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.800

muted.description: Secondary text on the light pages: the footer's column headings (Products, Resources).
muted.source: computed textStyle.color of footer default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.300

onDark.description: Text painted on the dark hero band and dark plan card.
onDark.source: computed color of hero-title default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.100

onDarkMuted.description: Muted text on the dark hero band.
onDarkMuted.source: computed color of hero-sub default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.white-alpha.52

accent.description: The orange CTA fill (painted by a layer inside the control).
accent.source: computed paint.0.bg of cta-accent default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.orange.500

accentText.description: Text painted on the orange CTA.
accentText.source: computed textStyle.color of cta-accent default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.100

ink.description: The dark pill fill (nav CTA, sign-in submit, logo-chip band).
ink.source: computed paint.0.bg of nav-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.800

inkHover.description: The lifted ink the dark pills pick up on hover.
inkHover.source: computed paint.0.bg of form-submit hover (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.500

navHover.description: The translucent orange wash behind a nav item on hover.

subtle.description: The dashed cream hairline inside the light plan card.
subtle.source: computed paint.1.border of plan-card default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.300

onDark.description: The dashed ink hairline inside the dark plan card.
onDark.source: computed paint.1.border of plan-card-dark default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.600

online.description: The 'All systems operational' dot: the only painted child (8 x 8, radius 100%) of the footer column the status-pill selector caught.

focus.description: The keyboard-focus ring the header/footer controls draw (1px auto); plan, slider and form controls still draw the #005fcc ring — recorded per entry.

heightInput.description: The sign-in field height on account.chargetrip.io.
